attributes.Agility: “ Agility represents character's reflexes, fleet-footedness, jumping ability, as well as affinity towards other athletic and acrobatic activities. Among other things it affects dodge, evasion, initiative and movement points. It also allows the character to move more quietly, increasing the stealth performance. ” — In-game description
attributes.Constitution: “ Constitution represents the health and general stamina of your character. It is important for all types of characters, but especially for those who plan on making the armor suit their main defense. It also helps prevent or lessen the effects of poisons and diseases. ” — In-game description
attributes.Dexterity: “ Dexterity measures character's reflexes, hand-eye coordination and finger nimbleness. It affects many things, such as operating locks, thievery, throwing and initiative. It increases critical strike chance of melee attacks. High dexterity also reduces action point cost of unarmed and light weapons (pistols, SMGs, knives, throwing knives, and fist weapons) ” — In-game description
attributes.Intelligence: “ Intelligence determines how well the character learns and reasons. It is important for a character that focuses on science as all disciplines are dependent on it. It also determines the number of different psi abilities that can be invoked during combat and affects psi point regeneration. ” — In-game description
attributes.Perception: “ Perception represents character's ability to discern objects from far away as well as to notice hidden things in their vicinity. It helps the character to use ranged weapons more effectively, as well as detect hidden objects, passages and creatures. ” — In-game description
attributes.Strength: “ Strength measures your character's muscle power. It affects melee damage and carry capacity. It's also important for characters who intend to use heavier weapons (such as sniper and assault rifles and sledgehammers). ” — In-game description
attributes.Will: “ Will measures character's mental determination to see to his actions regardless of various mental difficulties, such as pain, suggestion and overwhelming odds, as well as to force his will onto others and the environment. It heavily affects the potency of all psi disciplines, as well as psi point regeneration. ” — In-game description

feats.Advanced Psi Empathy: Base health reduced by additional 25% (additive to the original penalty) and psi cost of invoking psionic abilities reduced by 20% (multiplicative).
feats.Aimed Shot: You can perform an aimed shot with any single-target ranged weapon for a guaranteed critical hit. Cooldown: 3 turns.
feats.Ambush: When attacking an illuminated target from out of the darkness with a single-target ranged weapon you ignore half the target's evasion and your critical chance is increased by 20% plus 0,3% for each stealth skill point.
feats.Armor Sloping: Reduces the armor penalty originating from metal plates when crafting armor by 35% (multiplicative).
feats.Ballistics: Carrier vests give additional 3 mechanical damage threshold when used in crafting.
feats.Barrel Stare: Increases the damage done by your shotgun attacks to targets at close (near-melee) range by 20%.
feats.Beyond Cold: You've experienced that terrible feeling that lies on the other side of extreme cold, at the threshold of complete stillness, where the living body is drained of all energy. When chilled or frozen, you will gain a buff that will increase your Will by 1, reduce all the cold damage taken by 40% and all the mechanical damage taken by 15% and make you immune to further chilling or freezing for 3 turns. This can only occur only once every 10 turns.
feats.Blindsiding: Increases unarmed and weapon attack damage by 15% while in stealth and one turn after exiting stealth.
feats.Blitz: Grants you an ability that when invoked will instantly convert all your movement points to action points, granting you 1 action point for each 3 movement points, up to maximum of 20 action points. Cooldown: 10 turns.
feats.Boarding Up: Landing a melee attack while wearing a riot shield increases the amount blocked by the riot shield by 20% for 3 turns. Stacks up to 5 times.
feats.Body Horror: After what you have seen, you'll never look at the fleshly form the same again. Critical hit chance with weapons and unarmed attacks against humans and non-insectoid critters increased by 3%. Resolve reduced by 30%.
feats.Bone Breaker: Critical hits from your blunt melee attacks break ribs if they deal at least 4% of target's maximal health through mechanical damage. Targets with broken ribs receive additional 25% mechanical damage from all sources. This effect lasts 3 turns and stacks up to 2 times. Only works on targets that actually have ribs.
feats.Bowyer: Crossbows that you craft have their critical damage bonus increased by 35%. (additive)
feats.Brutality: When you kill a target with a melee attack, there's a 15% chance to instill fear in each nearby enemy for 1 turn.
feats.Brute Aim: Your Perception base ability is counted as being 3 points higher for the purpose of modifying the Heavy Guns skill.
feats.Bullet Time: When activated, reduces action point cost of firing firearm pistols by 30% until the end of the turn. Cannot reduce the action point cost below the hard minimum. Cooldown: 10 turns
feats.Bullet Trance: Grants 5% bonus damage to LMG and minigun attacks each time you kill an enemy with one of these weapons. Last 2 turns and stacks 5 times.
feats.Burglar: Reduces the time it takes to pick and hack locks by 75%. Also grants you a +10 bonus to stealth skill when in controlled areas.
feats.Cerebral Trauma: Increases the base damage of your Neural Overload psi ability by 20%. Also, whenever it lands it reduces all target's psi point reserves by 10% of their maximum psi points.
feats.Cheap Shots: Increases critical damage bonus of your melee attacks by 50% and gives your melee attacks 8% chance to incapacitate the target for 1 turn.
feats.Clothier: The quality of fabrics counts as if 20% higher in all your crafts.
feats.Cohesive Mucus Glands: Allows you to spit acid blobs that damage and entangle your targets.
feats.Combo: If you land three consecutive damage dealing unarmed or fist weapon attacks against a single target in a single turn, the third attack will deal 100% bonus damage and have 20% chance to stun the target for 1 turn.
feats.Commando: Killing an opponent using assault rifle or SMG burst attack will grant you an extra free burst attack that can be performed in the same turn. This can only happen once every turn.
feats.Concentrated Fire: Receives 10% extra damage from burst attacks.
feats.Concussive Shots: When you deal mechanical damage with your crossbow bolts you have 40% chance to daze living targets, reducing their action points by 15 and movement points by 30 for 1 turn.
feats.Conditioning: Reduces all mechanical, heat and cold damage taken by 10% plus 1% for every point in constitution above 5.
feats.Continuum Ripple: When your temporal distortion triggers, it has 25% chance to be applied to each nearby enemy. Distortions that came about in this way can now themselves trigger further distortions.
feats.Cooked Shot: Grants you a special attack with chemical blob pistols that launches a big blob at the targeted location, dealing normal weapon damage to everything in a small radius. This attack costs 150% of regular attack action points. Cooldown: 2 turns.
feats.Corporeal Projection: All telekinetic damage increased by 5% for each point of strength above 5.
feats.Crippling Strike: An unarmed, fist weapon or knife attack that deals 150% damage and reduces the target's strength by 2 if it penetrates armor. Lasts 5 turns. Stacks 3 times. Cooldown: 1 turn. Only works on living targets.
feats.Critical Power: For each 1% of weapon or unarmed attack critical damage bonus above 100%, you gain an additional 1% critical damage bonus.
feats.Cryogenic Induction: Increases the duration of all cold effects of your psi abilities by 1 turn and allows you to shatter targets caught in your cryostasis if the attack deals over 50% of target's remaining health (only mechanical and cold damage dealt is considered). Also increases the health of cryogenic barrier by 30%.
feats.Cut-Throat: You can perform a powerful knife stealth attack from behind the target that bypasses all resistances and shields, applies a bleeding wound that deals extra 800% damage over 3 turns and stuns the target for the same duration. You must either be hidden from your target through stealth or the target needs to be incapacitated. Only works on humans. Action point cost: 15. Cooldown: 6 turns.
feats.Deadly Snares: Your crossbow attacks always critically hit against the targets caught in bear traps and acidic entanglements.
feats.Decapitate: Grants you a special sword attack that deals 150% of normal weapon damage and can instantly kill a living target if it deals more than 50% of its remaining health (providing the target has an exposed head). Cooldown: 5 turns.
feats.Decommissioner: Unarmed and weapon damage increased by 15% against machines.
feats.Deflection: While unarmed or wielding fist weapons, your dodge is increased by 30% of your melee skill.
feats.Demolition Man: Getting hit by area of effect heat damage will grant 5% bonus damage to your grenade and rocket launcher attacks for 3 turns. Stacks 5 times.
feats.Dirty Kick: You can perform a special melee attack for 15 action points that deals increased unarmed damage and stuns living targets for 1 turn. If the target is human male, it's stunned for 2 turns instead. This attack can be performed regardless of the currently equipped weapon. The damage scales up with your unarmed attack damage. Cooldown: 6 turns.
feats.Disassemble: Grants you a blueprint that enables you to disassemble items that are marked as disassemble-able, obtaining the components from which it was constructed. The retrieved components have 90% of the original quality.
feats.Doctor: You can heal any wound with bandages. You also gain 25% more health from health restoring medications.
feats.Echoing Soliloquy: Slows down the rate at which the unspeakable things penetrate your mind.
feats.Escape Artist: Grants you the ability to remove all immobilization effects. Cooldown: 2 turns.
feats.Evasive Maneuvers: Grants you an ability that when activated converts all remaining movement points into thrice the evasion for 2 turns. Cooldown: 3 turns.
feats.Eviscerate: Grants you a special knife attack that removes all bleeding wounds from the target and deals 50% bonus damage for each bleeding wound removed. Cooldown: 1 turn.
feats.Execute: Grants you a special close range attack with the pistol that deals 250% weapon damage against stunned and incapacitated targets. Does not work with pistols that deal their primary damage to multiple targets. Costs 5 action points more than a regular attack. Cooldown: 5 turns.
feats.Expanded Psi Capacitance: Psi reserves increased by 30% and psi regeneration increased by amount equal to 1% of psi reserves maximum.
feats.Expert Dodging: Increases the chance you'll dodge a melee attack by 5% (additive).
feats.Expert Evasion: Increases the chance you'll evade a ranged attack by 5% (additive).
feats.Expert Sprint: Sprint now also grants 10 action points.
feats.Expert Unarmed Combat: Further increases unarmed damage by 20% and gives your unarmed attack 5% chance to stun the organic target for 1 turn.
feats.Expertise: Your non-critical crossbow, melee and bullet-based firearm attacks deal additional mechanical damage equal to your level, up to maximum 20 bonus damage.
feats.Expose Weakness: You can perform a special melee attack that deals normal damage and reduces target's mechanical resistance and threshold by 30%, plus additional 2% for each point of intelligence, for 2 turns if it lands. The effect is halved for non-living targets. Cooldown: 5 turns.
feats.Fancy Footwork: When you land a melee attack you gain up to 8 movement points, depending on your armor penalty. This can be triggered multiple times per turn, but each time the effect is reduced by 1 action point. This cannot raise your movement points beyond twice your normal maximum.
feats.Fast Metabolism: All healing increased by 25% and psi boosters restore extra 25 psi.
feats.Fatal Throw: Throwing Knives always critically hit against targets below 25% health. Killing a target with a knife throw will refund 18 action points (this can only happen once per turn).
feats.Fend: Grants you an ability to immediately gain Spear Guard that can block 150% more damage than normal for the action point cost of regular attack. Cooldown: 2 turns.
feats.Fight Response: When starting a turn below 25% of maximum health, your action points are increased by 10.
feats.Fine Tuned: You're starting to develop an ear for the subtle differences in sound. In a world comprised largely of dark caves and metro tunnels, this is no small boon. Detection increased by 15%
feats.Firebranded: To your deepest shame, your buttocks are marked with an ugly image of a billy goat. Max hit chance with weapons and unarmed attacks reduced by 1%.
feats.Fisherman: You never fail to reel the catch in.
feats.Flight Response: When starting a turn below 35% of maximum health, your movement points are increased by up to 25 (depending on your armor penalty).
feats.Flurry: Grants you an ability to launch 3 consecutive attacks with a sword. Each attack reduces the action point cost of further Flurry activations by 4 action points (this stacks 5 times) until the end of next turn. If any of the attacks misses or deals no damage, the flurry will stop and be put on cooldown for 3 turns and the cost reduction will be removed.
feats.Force User: Telekinesis is strong with you. Damage from your telekinetic punch is increased by 100%, your force field has 50% more health and lasts 2 more turns, and your force emission costs 1 less psi point.
feats.Forceful Innervation: You conditioned your mind for psionic powers the raw way and it left its mark on you. You use your Will base ability instead of Intelligence to determine the number of psi slots, but your max psi points are reduced by 10. You obtained the rare golden pill that might undo this, but you are not sure if you should use it.
feats.Fragmented Chaos: Increases critical damage bonus of your shotgun attacks by 250% divided by number of pellets fired.
feats.Future Orientation: Reduces cooldowns of all temporal manipulation psi abilities that have cooldown by 1 turn, and increases action point cost for those psi abilities by 5, providing they have action point cost.
feats.Grenadier: Reduces the cooldown of fragmentation, high explosive and incendiary grenades by 2 turns and special grenades by 3 turns.
feats.Guard: You have 35% chance to block melee mechanical damage equal to twice your strength. Does not work if stunned or otherwise fully disabled.
feats.Gun Nut: Increases the upper damage range of all firearms you create by 15%.
feats.Gun-Fu: When attacking with firearm pistols in melee range, your effective attacks skill is increased by 40% of your unmodified melee skill for all purposes, including the damage done.
feats.Gunner's High: Whenever you deal damage to an enemy with a machine gun or minigun attack you gain an effect that heals you for one health each turn for 10 turns, but cannot heal above 65% of your maximum health. Stacks 10 times.
feats.Gunslinger: Reduces the amount of action points required to fire pistols by 3 and increases initiative by 7 while wielding one. Only applies to firearms.
feats.Heavy Metal: Reduces mechanical damage taken by 1% for each point of weapon's strength requirement, and grants bonus damage equal to 50% (half of that for rocket launchers) of the total armor penalty when attacking with heavy guns. Only works when heavy guns or sledgehammers are equipped in both weapon slots and total armor penalty is 50% or higher.
feats.Heavy Punch: You can perform an unarmed or fist weapon attack that deals 300% damage at 150% action point cost. Cooldown: 3 turns.
feats.Heavyweight: You add your total armor penalty to the critical damage bonus of sledgehammer, fist weapon and unarmed attacks.
feats.Hemopsychosis: Grants you an ability that when activated will make all your psi abilities cost health instead of psi until the end of the turn. Cooldown: 5 turns
feats.High-Technicalities: Increases damage done by energy weapons and attachments (those that deal electric and energy damage) by 8% for each intelligence point above 5.
feats.Hit and Run: Every time you kill an enemy with your melee or ranged weapon your movement points are reset to 25 (cannot exceed your maximum) if they were below that number. This can happen multiple times in the same turn, but each consecutive time the effect gets halved.
feats.Hypertoxicity: Increases damage done by poisons you apply by 100%.
feats.Hypothermia: Your cryokinesis and cryostasis psi abilities also reduce target's constitution by 1. This effect stacks up to 5 times and lasts up to 24 turns. Can be mitigated with cold resistance and targets that are immune to chilling and freezing effects are also immune to hypothermia.
feats.Impale: Grants you a special attack with the spear that automatically critically hits if it lands. Cooldown: 3 turns.
feats.Improved Naval Combat: Further increases effective stability by 15% and maneuverability by 10% when piloting jet skis. Further reduces action point cost of disembarking by 10. Also increases precision of mounted jet ski weapons for those unproficient with guns.
feats.Improved Unarmed Combat: Increases unarmed damage by 20% and gives your unarmed attack 5% chance to daze the target for 1 turn.
feats.Interloper: Lowers the stealth movement speed penalty to 30% and allows you to retain up to 15 movement points in combat while stealthed.
feats.Iron Grip: Allows you to wield spears in one hand when wearing an armor with a riot shield, but at 15% penalty to weapon damage.
feats.Jet 'n' Jab: Removes the additional 10% stability penalty with knife, fist weapon and unarmed attacks when riding jet skis.
feats.Juggernaut: Total health increased by 25% while wearing armor suit with (unmodified) armor penalty of 50% or higher.
feats.Kneecap Shot: Deals normal weapon damage and inflicts a bleeding wound that deals additional 125% damage over 3 turns and removes all movement points from the target (target can still move using action points). Can only be performed with a pistol, crossbow or SMG.
feats.Last Stand: Grants you an ability that when activated it will temporarily reset your health to your maximum for 2 turns. After the effect expires, your health will be reduced to 1. Cooldown: 10 turns.
feats.Leading Shot: Your shotgun attacks ignore 65% of target's evasion as long as there are no enemies in melee range to disrupt you.
feats.Lightning Punches: Reduces the action point cost of your unarmed and fist weapon attacks by 2 while your armor penalty is below 20%.
feats.Locus of Control: You are the master of your own fate. Activate this ability to remove and gain immunity to stun, fear, incapacitation, and mind control for 3 turns. While this effect is active you can invoke any thought control ability as an area of effect ability, but that will end the effect. Cooldown: 15 turns.
feats.Mad Chemist: On-hit effects of chemical pistols you create are twice as strong.
feats.Mag Dump: Further increases number of extra rounds for LMG burst by 2, and increases the amount of extra rounds you get for each wind up stack when bursting with a minigun by 0,5.
feats.Major Supplier: Increases the amount of money the merchants are willing to use when trading with you by 2% per mercantile skill.
feats.Marksman: Removes additional action point cost when firing special bolts.
feats.Mental Subversion: Each offensive mind affecting psi ability you land on the target reduces its resolve by a small percentage, but can ultimately stack up to 75%.
feats.Monster Slayer: Unarmed and weapon damage increased by 15% against creatures.
feats.Monstrous Yell: Your Yell makes such a disturbing sound that it also has a 30% chance to instill fear for 1 turn.
feats.Motioner: You abused this dangerous substance one too many times and now your brain has suffered long-term damage. Yout intelligence is reduced by 1 and you occasionally suffer worse acute effects.
feats.Naval Combat: Increases effective stability by 15% and maneuverability by 10% when piloting jet skis. Reduces action point cost of disembarking by 10. Also increases precision of mounted jet ski weapons for those unproficient with guns.
feats.Naval Jousting: Increases damage with spears when riding jet skis by 30%.
feats.Neural Overclocking: Critical damage bonus of all psi abilities increased by 30%.
feats.Neurology: Psi headbands you create also provide additional 15 maximum psi points.
feats.Nimble: Reduces armor penalty by 15% and grants 15% bonus to dodge and evasion if your armor penalty is at zero.
feats.Ninja Looter: Reduces pickpocketing time by 50%. Also reduces suspicion raised when pickpocketing by 25% when hidden from the target.
feats.Onslaught: Your successful sword attacks increase the damage of further sword attacks by 5% for 2 turns. Stacks 20 times. This bonus will be removed if a sword attack misses or does no damage.
feats.Outer Visions: You've seen the wonderous possibilities of the Outer Expanses, both the beautiful and the abominable, and you're now less inclined to believe in the necessity of the limits of this particular physical world. Range of all psi abilities increased by 1.
feats.Paranoia: Everyone is out to get you and you know it. Detection increased by 20%, initiative by 5 and chance to get critically hit by weapon and unarmed attacks reduced by 3%. Also your weapon and unarmed damage is increased by 30% against stealthed targets.
feats.Parry: While holding a sword or a knife, the character has 25% plus 3% per point of dexterity above 6 chance to block a melee attack. The amount blocked is equal to the average base mechanical damage of the current weapon in case of swords and twice that for knives.
feats.Pellet Mayhem: Your shotgun attacks grant you additional 3% critical chance for each target you hit for the next shotgun shot.
feats.Perfect Scattering: Each shotgun pellet you fire does additional 1 to 2 points of mechanical damage.
feats.Pinning: Your throwing knives have 35% chance to pin living targets to the ground for one turn.
feats.Point Shot: Grants you the ability to perform a quick pistol, SMG or assault rifle attack that costs 50% of the standard action point cost but has reduced precision. Cooldown: 1 turn.
feats.Polymath: Immediately grants 15 skill points and an additional 5 skill points at every subsequent level.
feats.Power Management: Electronic devices you create have 35% greater energy capacity.
feats.Practical Physicist: Critical damage bonus of energy weapons you create is increased by 25% (additive).
feats.Practiced Parabola: Increases precision with grenade launchers by 5% and reduces the maximum grenade miss distance by 1.
feats.Premeditation: When activated this ability will reduce the psi cost of your next psi ability by 50%, its action point cost by 100% and increase its range by 3. The range is not increased for channeled abilities. Cooldown: 5 turns.
feats.Psi Empathy: Allows the character to learn and invoke psi abilities, but their base health is reduced by 20%.
feats.Psionic Mania: Grants you an ability that when activated makes your next offensive psi ability an automatic critical hit. Activating this ability will also remove up to 15% of your health, but cannot kill you. Cooldown: 5 turns.
feats.Psycho-neural Flexibility: One psi school is ignored when determining the multi-school innervation psi cost penalty
feats.Psycho-neural Optimization: Whille having only one psi school innervated, the psi cost of all abilities is reduced by 10%
feats.Psycho-temporal Acceleration: Increases action point modification of all psycho-temporal effects by 5 and increases their duration by 1 turn.
feats.Psychokinetic Elasticity: Increases the range of your telekinetic psi abilities, and also the number of links in your psychokinetic chains you produce, by one.
feats.Psychosis: Increases critical chance of all psi abilities by 15%, but also increases their psi point cost by 20%.
feats.Psychostatic Electricity: When you damage a target with your electrical psionics you apply a debuff that increases the chance for the target to be critically hit by weapon and unarmed attacks and psi abilities by 5% for 2 turns. Stacks 5 times.
feats.Pummel: You can perform a special attack with a sledgehammer that deals 50% weapon damage and does not ignore damage threshold, but puts living targets off balance for 2 turns if it lands. Off-balanced characters have their dodge and evasion reduced to zero. Cooldown: 1 turns
feats.Pyromaniac: Whenever you deal damage with your fire based psi abilities you have a chance to set the target on fire, dealing 100% of that damage again over 3 turns. Setting living targets on fire will put them in state of extreme panic.
feats.Quick Pockets: Provides you with an extra utility slot and reduces the action point cost of equipping items during combat by 50%.
feats.Quick Tinkering: Grants you an ability that when activated will allow you to arm your next trap instantly, even in combat in which case it will cost 25 action points. Cooldown: 5 turns.
feats.Rapid Fire: Grants you the ability to rapidly fire 3 bullets from firearm pistols, SMGs, and assault rifles at reduced precision for 150% action point cost of a regular attack.
feats.Rearm: Picks up the closest thrown spear from the ground
feats.Recklessness: Increases your chance to critically hit with weapons and unarmed attacks by 7%, but also increases your chance to get critically hit by weapon and unarmed attacks and psi abilities by 3%.
feats.Remote Surgeon: Increases the unresisted damage modifier of throwing knives by additional 50%.
feats.Riposte: When you block any damage while holding a sword, you can perform a special sword attack with increased chance to hit that deals normal weapon damage at no action point cost.
feats.Salesman: Increases the amount of goods merchants will buy from you by 1% per mercantile skill.
feats.Sap: Grants 20% damage bonus when attacking with crowbars and allows you to perform a special crowbar attack from behind the target that bypasses all resistances and shields and incapacitates the target for up to 5 turns. You must either be hidden from your target through stealth or the target needs to be incapacitated. Only works on humanoids. Cooldown: 6 turns.
feats.Scrutinous: Increases critical chance of unarmed and weapon attacks by 7%.
feats.Sea Dog: Increases unarmed and weapon damage by 30% and effective stability and maneuverability by 10% when attacking from a jet ski.
feats.Serial Killer: Unarmed and weapon damage increased by 10% against humanoids.
feats.Shadow Tricks: If you spend more than 6 seconds in stealth, you will gain 20% displacement. This effect will persist for the duration of the stealth mode and 6 seconds afterwards.
feats.Sharpshooter: Increases your critical damage bonus with pistols, crossbows and sniper rifles when fully focused by 30%. Firearm pistols receive this bonus at all times, regardless of focus.
feats.Shell Shock: All humanoids caught in the blast radius of your grenade or rocket launcher's projectile have their offensive and defensive skills reduced by 4% for 3 turns. This stacks 5 times.
feats.Shield Arm: Increases the chance to block with shields by 15% (additive) and the amount blocked by 30%.
feats.Shield Bash: Grants you a melee attack that deals mechanical damage equal to 75%-125% of the amount blocked by the carried riot shield and dazes the target for 1 turn. Cooldown: 2 turns.
feats.Shoemaker: The quality of leathers counts as if 10% higher when crafting leather boots
feats.Shooting Spree: Grants you an ability that when activated will cause your next sniper rifle attack to refund 100% of its action point cost if it kills the target. This will expire at the end of the turn if unused. Cooldown: 10 turns Also, killing a target with a sniper rifle reduces the cooldown of Shooting Spree and Aimed Shot by 1 turn.
feats.Sixth Shell: Each shotgun shot will grant 10% bonus damage to shotgun attacks. When stacked up to 5, this damage bonus will change to 100% and after the sixth attack the bonus will reset.
feats.Skinner: The quality of leathers counts as if 20% higher in all your crafts.
feats.Snipe: Grants you a special attack with a crossbow or a sniper rifle that deals 225% weapon damage plus additional 1% damage per stealth skill point. Can only be used in stealth. This attack cannot critically hit. Cooldown: 3 turns
feats.Snooping: Increases perception by 3 for the purpose of detecting hidden passages and other secrets.
feats.Spear Guardian: Increases the block chance of Spear Guard by 30%.
feats.Spear Throw: Grants you the ability to throw a spear at the target, dealing 125%, plus additional 20% per unit of range, of normal weapon damage. The precision of this attack is dependent on throwing skill. Costs 25 action points. Cooldown: 1 turn. You will usually be able to retrieve the thrown spear afterwards, as it lands nearby the target, at no action point cost.
feats.Spec Ops: Reduces action point cost modifier for burst attack from 300% to 200% when using SMGs. Also reduces cooldown of flashbangs and similar tactical grenades by 1 turn.
feats.Special Tactics: Grants you an ability that when activated will remove the action point cost of your next special bolt attack. This ability can only be activated while out of combat. Cooldown: 6 turns.
feats.Specialist: Grants one additional specialization point per level.
feats.Split Spare: When throwing knives you throw an extra one at a nearby target that's within the attack cone.
feats.Sprint: You can activate the Sprint ability which grants you 30 additional movement points for 2 turns. Only effective out of stealth. Cooldown: 10 turns.
feats.Steadfast Aim: Increases critical hit chance with a pistol by 0.5% for each base action point required to fire it above 10.
feats.Stoicism: You receive 1% less damage from all sources for each 4% health missing.
feats.Strafe: Reduces move and shoot penalty by 15%.
feats.Strider: Increase unstealthed movement points by 15 and out of combat unstealthed movement speed by 15%.
feats.Stuntman: Reduces the damage taken from area of effect attacks by 20% (additive to regular evasion).
feats.Super Slam: Grants you a special attack with the sledgehammer that does normal damage plus 20% of attacker's maximum health as additional mechanical damage. Cooldown: 3 turns.
feats.Suppressive Fire: Enemies caught in your firearm burst attack cone (regardless of whether they've been shot) have their ranged chance to hit reduced by 10%, action points reduced by 5 and movement points reduced by 10 for 1 turn.
feats.Sure Step: You can safely navigate caltrops and puddles of acid.
feats.Survival Instincts: Increases the chance to critically hit with weapons, unarmed attacks and psi abilities by 30% while under 30% health.
feats.Sweep: Grants you a special spear attack which deals 70% of normal weapon damage to all enemies adjacent to you and puts living targets off balance for 2 turns if they are hit. Off-balanced characters have their dodge and evasion reduced to zero. Cooldown: 3 turns.
feats.Taste for Blood: Whenever you attack a bleeding target with a melee weapon, you increase your melee damage by 5% for each bleeding wound the target has. This can stack up to 10 times. Killing blows against living targets will also grant a single stack regardless of the number of bleeding wounds. Expires after 1 turn if not refreshed.
feats.Telekinetic Undulation: When you damage a living target by moving your telekinetic proxy, there's 50% chance it will be dazed for 1 turn.
feats.Tempered: Acid: Reduces all acid damage taken by 30%
feats.Tempered: Cold: Reduces all cold damage taken by 30%
feats.Tempered: Electricity: Reduces all electrical damage taken by 30%
feats.Tempered: Heat: Reduces all heat damage taken by 30%
feats.Thermodynamicity: After invoking heat based psi ability you gain thermodynamicity which reduces the action point cost of your next cold based psi ability by 50% and vice versa. If unused, the bonus expires after 2 turns.
feats.Thick Skull: Whenever you should be stunned, you're dazed instead which reduces your action points by 15 but still allows you to act.
feats.Three-Pointer: Gives your damage dealing grenades 10% chance to critically hit. This chance is increased by 1.5% for each 10 points in throwing skill above 50.
feats.Tranquility: Reduces the action point cost of all psi abilities by 5 while at full health.
feats.Trap Expert: Reduces the time required to arm and disarm traps by 60% and increases the detection difficulty of the traps you set by 25%. | requirements = * Dexterity 6 * Traps 30
feats.Tricky Trajectory: Area of effect weapons deal 10% bonus damage and ignore 30% of target's evasion. This works with all non-thrown area of effect weapons, including those mounted on vehicles.
feats.Uncanny Dodge: Grants you an ability that when activated this ability will cause you to dodge the next 2 regular or special melee attacks targeted against you, plus an additional attack for each 30 points in dodge. Cooldown: 5 turns.
feats.Vile Weaponry: Whenever you cause a bleeding wound with a cold weapon, armor enhancement or trap you also apply infected wound which increases the damage taken from all sources by 10% and reduces healing effects by 25%. Stacks 3 times.
feats.Weaponsmith: Non-fist melee weapons that you create have 5% higher critical hit chance.
feats.Wrestling: When you strike a living target with fist weapon or unarmed attack you have 50% chance to reduce target's movement points by 8, action points by 3 and chance to hit with all ranged weapons by 7%. Stacks 5 times.
feats.Yell: You can issue an intimidating shout in an attempt to reduce combat readiness of surrounding enemies and remove them from stealth. All affected enemies will have their offensive skills reduced by an amount equal to 35% of your intimidation skill for 3 turns. Cooldown: 10 turns.

skills.Biology: “ Represents your knowledge of biology. This skill is primarily used in crafting various items, such as healing and psi restoring concoctions. It also enables you to extract useful substances from plants and animals. ” — In-game description
skills.Chemistry: “ Represents your knowledge of chemistry. This skill is primarily used in crafting various items, such as explosives. ” — In-game description
skills.Crossbows: “ Increases your precision and damage with crossbows. ” — In-game description
skills.Dodge: “ Increases your chance to avoid melee attacks. ” — In-game description
skills.Electronics: “ Represents your knowledge of electronics. This skill is primarily used in crafting various items, such as various electronic utilies and energy weapons. ” — In-game description
skills.Evasion: “ Increases your chance to avoid a ranged attack. Reduces damage you receive from area of effect attacks. ” — In-game description
skills.Guns: “ Increases your precision and damage with any type of pistol, SMG or rifle. This includes both firearms and energy weapons. Also, the higher your skill level, the more advanced weapons you can wield effectively. ” — In-game description
skills.Hacking: “ Allows you to hack all kinds of computer devices, such as electronic locks, cameras, sentry turrets, etc. ” — In-game description
skills.Heavy Guns: “ Increases your precision and damage with machine guns and handheld miniguns. Also, the higher your skill level, the more advanced weapons you can wield effectively. ” — In-game description
skills.Intimidation: “ Your ability to make someone act out of fear. ” — In-game description
skills.Lockpicking: “ Allows you to pick mechanical locks and dismantle other mechanical barriers such as ventilation shafts. ” — In-game description
skills.Mechanics: “ Represents your knowledge of mechanics. This skill is primarily used in crafting various items, such as weapons, armors and traps. ” — In-game description
skills.Melee: “ Increases damage with melee weapons and unarmed attacks and helps you overcome your target's dodge rating. ” — In-game description
skills.Mercantile: “ Your ability to work out favorable prices in a business transaction. ” — In-game description
skills.Metathermics: “ Ability of mind to initiate and control rapid temperature changes and harness exothermic and endothermic energies. ” — In-game description
skills.Persuasion: “ Your ability to convince the other party to see things your way through non-violent means. ” — In-game description
skills.Pickpocketing: “ Allows you to steal items from other characters. ” — In-game description
skills.Psychokinesis: “ Ability of the mind to exert mechanical force, as well as to emit electric currents and project electromagnetic fields. ” — In-game description
skills.Stealth: “ Decreases the chance that you'll be spotted while in stealth mode. Also affects numerous aspects of stealth combat. ” — In-game description
skills.Tailoring: “ Represents your skill in tailoring leather and cloth materials into pieces of armor. ” — In-game description
skills.Temporal Manipulation: “ Ability of mind to manipulate time or time perception on very local level, including partial time suspension, reversal and recurrence. ” — In-game description
skills.Thought Control: “ Ability to influence the minds of other living creatures through mental suggestion and domination. Also the ability to focus and enhance your own mental processes and to take greater control of your body. ” — In-game description
skills.Throwing: “ Increases your precision with all throwing weapons and utilities, including grenades. ” — In-game description
skills.Traps: “ Allows you to plant and disarm increasingly more powerful traps. The higher your skill is the harder your traps are to spot and disarm. Also increases your chance of spotting traps. ” — In-game description
